changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwprocedurecoding AS SELECT pc.id, pc.procedure_id, pc.code_type, pc.code_id, pc.created_by, pc.created_date, pc.last_modified_by, pc.last_modified_date FROM public.procedure_coding pc;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwprocedurecoding TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwprocedurecoding FROM report_user;
